:py:mod:`futuram.utils.object_import_export`
============================================

.. py:module:: futuram.utils.object_import_export

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   object_import_export.py

   This is a script to export and import the model and other model objects to file. Export formats are:

   - JSON
   - pickle

   Methods:

   - export(model_object, filename, format='pickle'):

       Wrapper function to export the model object to file.

   - export_to_json(model_object, filename)

   - export_to_pickle(model_object, filename)

   - import(filename)

   Dependencies:

   - pickle
   - json
   - datetime
   - os

   #! this has not yet been fully tested. it could be that the model object is not fully exported to json and then imported again. the pickel export and import seems to work fine though. maybe we need to make a function to convert the model object to a fully to a dictionary first.

.. py:function:: import_object(filename=None)

   This is a function to import a model object from file.
   If there is no filename specified, it will import the latest file from the export folder.

   :param filename: The filename to import the model object from.

                    Default filename is the object name and the date and time of export. Default location is the export folder.
   :type filename: str
   :param Usage example:
   :param -------------:
   :param TestModel_ELV = import('TestModel_ELV-20230707-1620.pkl'):


.. py:function:: export_object(model_object, filename=None, file_format='pickle')

   This is a wrapper function to export the model object to file.



.. py:function:: export_to_json(model_object, filename)

   Exports the model object to a JSON file.

   :param model_object: The model object to export. (can be a model,process, flow, or matter object)
   :param filename: The filename to export the model object to.
                    without the .json extension.
   :type filename: str
   :param Default filename is the object name and the current date and time. Default location is the export folder.:


.. py:function:: export_to_pickle(model_object, filename)

   Exports the model object to a pickle file.

   :param model_object: The model object to export. (can be a model,process, flow, or matter object)
   :param filename: The filename to export the model object to.
                    without the .pkl extension.
   :type filename: str
   :param Default filename is the object name and the current date and time. Default location is the export folder.:
